# SMARAN.AI

> The private, offline-first AI desktop assistant running on your own machine. 
> Free and open for Windows, Android, and Command Line.

## Overview
SMARAN.AI is an offline-capable, local-first artificial intelligence assistant. It executes local large language models (LLMs) directly on your personal computer hardware without requiring mandatory internet access, subscription fees, or account creation.

## Key Capabilities
- **Local-First Architecture**: Run 63+ open models (Llama 3, DeepSeek, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) entirely offline on your GPU/CPU via llama.cpp or Ollama.
- **Voice & Live Conversation**: Real-time voice interaction with both fully offline local speech-to-text / text-to-speech models and low-latency cloud engines (Google Gemini Multimodal Live).
- **Vision & Multimodal Screen Analysis**: Analyze documents, screenshots, webcam feeds, and on-screen code without uploading private data to remote servers.
- **Computer Use & Autonomous Agents**: Integrated with Google Agents CLI and operating system automation to manage files, terminal tasks, and workspaces safely.
- **Phone Pairing**: Synchronized Android companion app that works standalone or paired with your PC over local WiFi for shared memory and remote control.
- **100% Privacy by Default**: Chat history, memory embeddings, personal documents, and audio recordings remain strictly on your local disk (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\SMARAN.AI`).

## Installation & System Requirements
- **Platforms Supported**:
  - Windows 10/11 (64-bit x86_64) via `SMARAN.AI-Setup.exe`
  - Android (APK)
  - Linux / WSL (Headless & CLI via curl)
- **Minimum Requirements**:
  - RAM: 4 GB (Small models: Qwen 0.5B, Phi-3 Mini) to 16 GB+ (Llama 3 8B, DeepSeek 7B)
  - Storage: ~1 GB for base application, 2–10 GB for model weights
  - GPU: Optional (NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, or CPU execution supported)
